name: Fire and Gas
description: F&G detection covers flame (UV/IR), smoke, heat, combustible/toxic gas and pneumatic fusible plug loops, interfaced to deluge, ESD, PAGA and the ICSS. Offshore Norge assigns SIL 2 to single-detector fire and gas detection sub-functions.
aliases: Fire and Gas (F&G) detection: flame, smoke, heat and gas detectors, fusible plug loops
